connector.name: Splitifi Intelligence MCP
connector.registryDescription: Outcome predictions and judge profiles from 2,741 ML models trained on 30.3M court records.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package splitifi-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the mysplitifi account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: SPLITIFI_API_KEY
env.description: Your Splitifi API key. Get one at mysplitifi.com/developers. Keys start with sk_live_ (production) or sk_test_ (sandbox — all tools unlocked, synthetic responses).

env.name: SPLITIFI_API_URL
env.description: Override the backend URL. Defaults to https://backend.mysplitifi.com/api/v1/intelligence. Set to http://localhost:8080/api/v1/intelligence for local development.
